title: Wildly Tender Ukrainian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and umami-rich stew featuring tender beef, piccalilli, and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a cold winter's night. This diabetic-friendly dish is slow-cooked to perfection.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then add the beef and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the piccalilli, beef broth, tomato paste, and dried thyme, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the stew and continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 30 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve with a side of whole grain bread or over mashed potatoes.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
